```{r}
library(Biostrings)
```
```{r}
fa <- readDNAStringSet("rosalind_gc.txt")
lf <- letterFrequency(fa, "CG" )[,1] #returns a table so needs to be converted
w_vec <- width(fa)
freq_vec <- lf/w_vec
indx <- which.max(freq_vec)
names(fa)[indx]
freq_vec[indx] * 100 #wants perc format
```
